model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for 2-Fbit and 4-Fbit configurations. The horizontal axis represents the block index, labeled from 0 to 79 in increments of approximately 20, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity, labeled on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^-7 to 10^-4. Each block index is associated with a pair of bars, colored green for 2-Fbit and blue for 4-Fbit, indicating their respective sensitivities. For block indices 0 to 49, the green bars are present, with values between approximately 5 x 10^-7 and 6 x 10^-6, while for block indices 50 to 79, the blue bars are present, with values between approximately 7 x 10^-6 and 1.2 x 10^-4. The bars are grouped by block index, with the two bars for each index positioned adjacent to each other. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars beyond their sequential arrangement by block index. The blue bars appear only for the higher block indices (50 to 79), while the green bars are visible for the lower block indices (0 to 49).
model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates the sensitivity of different block indices for two types of quantization: 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit. The horizontal axis represents the block index, labeled from 0 to 79, while the vertical axis represents sensitivity on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^-7 to 10^-4. The bars are grouped by block index, with each group containing two bars: one for 4-Fbit (blue) and one for 2-Fbit (green). For block indices 0-49, only the 2-Fbit bars are visible, with values ranging from approximately 5 x 10^-7 to 5 x 10^-6. For block indices 50-79, both 4-Fbit and 2-Fbit bars are visible, with the 4-Fbit bars being generally taller, ranging from approximately 1 x 10^-5 to 1.2 x 10^-4, while the 2-Fbit bars continue the trend observed for block indices 0-49. The bars are not sorted in any particular order except for being grouped by block index. No bars are visually emphasized beyond the color coding for the two types of quantization.
